content.text: Hi, Am I right in thinking maybe Line 193 of InternalAuditor.java might be a reason:
final String uuid = pidMinter.mitPid();
If we get the existing identifier from the FedoraEvent, we use that instead of the above line?
Yes, that sounds like a good idea.  I'm not sure if the event already has a good identifier that could be used, or if we should also update the event-generation process to mint one.
I have a PR for the first part of this: minting an ID when events are generated and adding it to the JMS event, so downstream consumers can use it to build the same identifiers for the events:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/pull/812
Next up will be updated the camel and internal event processors to use the new ID.
PR 2 of 4: Adding a header to the main Camel project:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-camel/pull/73
PRs 3 and 4:
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/pull/14
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/pull/33
These will require PRs 1 and 2 to be merged before their tests will pass.
Pending response to code review comments.
I have addressed the PR comments and updated all four PRs
Resolved with the following commits:
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo4/commit/75916010e5dfbdc74e4e415837e3366babbbc834
https://github.com/fcrepo4/fcrepo-camel/commit/c301fffc122199109f34f21b8e1e2db9c99fd306
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/commit/4be506655fde769eacc416716bce26b44a7bcfaa
https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-camel-toolbox/commit/1aa699481fd87466eac3854340fdf11ca74daddc
Both audit-triplestore and fcrepo-audit auto-generate identifiers for event nodes, leading to different identifiers for the same events stored in two different places.
We should generate a single identifier when the events are converted from JCR to Fedora events, and use that identifier in both places for consistency.
